text:
sam: FYI opened a PR that changes the inference API contract and hooks up a new routing flag. blocked on arch review and RFC link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342

zahra: looking now. can you paste the RFC link? i don't see it referenced in the PR description.

sam: good catch — forgot to add it. RFC is https://redwood.example.com/rfcs/rfc-402-inference-routing. main concern: the new field `route_policy` defaults to 'cost-prefer' which might change fallbacks.

emily: quick question — does this change the SLO for p95? if so we need the perf numbers in the RFC or CI checks.

sam: it shouldn't change p95 for existing models; only applies when model routing mismatch occurs. added a short note to the RFC but happy to expand.

azahra: i'll do an architecture pass but i need the rollout plan in the PR. add canary plan and fallback behavior (e.g., fallback to local-quantized model) or we keep previous behavior.

sam: added canary steps to the PR description and a snippet of the rollback policy: ```
canary: 3% traffic -> 10% -> 50% over 24h
fallback: route_policy=null -> previous-model
monitoring: trace + token-latency alerts at 10% deviation
```

emily: thanks. also please call out any storage/kv-cache implications — will the route key touch the cache keyspace?

sam: short answer: yes, i added a note in the RFC section 'KV namespace' — it prefixes keys with `route:`. i'll expand in the PR.

azahra: cool. i'll review end-to-end. if i sign off, we still need arch-bot to stamp the RFC as approved (we're gating merges on RFC-approval for protocol changes).

arch-bot: Automated check: RFC rfc-402 status = pending-review. To mark approved, add `arch:approve` label to the RFC page and ping @zahra.

emily: pinging @zahra — that's the final step for merge gating.

azahra: on it. doing a quick read, will leave inline comments. please don't merge until i confirm.

sam: understood — thanks. i've set the PR as "do not merge" and added `needs-arch` label. :thumbsup:

emily: CI green btw: all unit/integration tests passed except lint in one file — small fix incoming.

sam: pushed lint fix. thanks everyone.

azahra: left two small comments about error semantics. otherwise LGTM pending RFC approve.

emily: once RFC approved i can help land and coordinate the canary window.

sam: will follow up once @zahra flips the RFC label. cheers!
